name: Check freee expense deals with Gemini AI, log to kintone, notify via Chatwork

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs every weekday at 9:00. While testing, use 'Execute workflow' to run it manually.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Replace every REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_... value with your own freee company ID, kintone subdomain and app ID, Chatwork room ID, and Google Drive folder ID.

nodes.name: freee API - Get expense deals
nodes.notes: Fetches expense deals issued on the previous business day (up to 50). Monday looks back to Friday.

nodes.name: Split deals into items
nodes.notes: Splits the freee deals array into one item per deal so each deal is processed separately.

nodes.name: Gemini - Check expense details
nodes.notes: Asks Gemini to return a strict JSON judgement (REQUIRES_REVIEW or OK) with a short comment for each deal.

nodes.name: Parse Gemini judgement
nodes.notes: Merges Gemini's judgement with the original deal data. If the response cannot be parsed, the deal is treated as REQUIRES_REVIEW to be safe.

nodes.name: Filter - Flagged deals only
nodes.notes: Only deals that Gemini flagged as REQUIRES_REVIEW continue. Deals judged OK are dropped here.

nodes.name: kintone API - Check for duplicate
nodes.notes: Searches kintone for the same deal ID so a deal that was already logged on a previous run is not recorded twice.

nodes.name: IF - Not already logged
nodes.notes: True branch: no existing record was found, so the deal is logged and archived.

nodes.name: kintone API - Create record
nodes.notes: Field codes in the body (e.g. the deal ID and AI comment fields) must match the field codes of your own kintone app.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ app: $('Config').item.json.kintone_app_id, record: { 日付: { value: $('Parse Gemini judgement').item.json.issue_date }, 数値: { value: $('Parse Gemini judgement').item.json.amount }, 文字列__1行__1: { value: String($('Parse Gemini judgement').item.json.id) }, 文字列__複数行_: { value: $('Parse Gemini judgement').item.json.ai_comment }, 文字列__1行_: { value: String($('Parse Gemini judgement').item.json.details[0].account_item_id) } } }) }}

nodes.name: Google Drive API - Archive receipt summary
nodes.notes: Saves a JSON summary with Gemini's comment for each newly logged deal to your Google Drive folder.

parameters.content:
### How it works
1. Every weekday morning, this workflow pulls every freee expense deal from the previous business day.
2. Each deal is split into its own item and sent to Gemini, which flags anything unusual in the amount, account item, or date as REQUIRES_REVIEW (or OK otherwise).
3. Only the flagged deals continue — everything Gemini judged normal is filtered out, so your team only sees transactions that actually need a human look.
4. Before logging anything, the workflow checks kintone to make sure that deal hasn't already been recorded on a previous run, preventing duplicate entries.
5. Each new flagged deal is saved as a kintone record (with Gemini's comment attached), archived as a JSON summary to Google Drive, and then all of them are combined into a single digest.
6. One Chatwork message is posted summarizing every flagged deal from this run, so your accounting team knows exactly what to check — without being spammed with one message per transaction.

### Setup steps
1. Connect your freee, Gemini, kintone, Google Drive, and Chatwork credentials.
2. Open the Config node and fill in your freee company ID, kintone subdomain and app ID, Chatwork room ID, Gemini model, and Google Drive folder ID.
3. Make sure your kintone app has fields matching: issue date, amount, deal ID, AI comment, and account item ID.
4. Activate the workflow, or adjust the Schedule Trigger to your preferred time.

Trigger & config
- Runs on a schedule (weekday mornings by default)
- Loads account IDs, room IDs, and other settings from one place

Fetch, split & judge
- Pulls every expense deal from the previous business day
- Splits them into individual deals
- Asks Gemini to flag anything unusual in the amount, account item, or date, returning a strict REQUIRES_REVIEW / OK judgement

Filter & dedupe
- Keeps only deals Gemini flagged as REQUIRES_REVIEW
- Checks kintone to skip deals that were already logged on a previous run

Log, archive & notify
- Saves each new flagged deal and AI comment as a kintone record
- Archives a JSON summary of each check to Google Drive
- Combines all flagged deals from this run into a single digest and posts one Chatwork notification, so accounting isn't spammed with individual messages
